messages:
nina_cs: Quick check — cohort Epsilon enrollment is at 18/25 seats. I want to run a 15m 'first week' sync + a 1-question feedback pulse after session. Who can cover enablement + follow-up?

sam_se: I can cover enablement Tue 10–10:30 PT. Will demo integration flow and share sample creds.

ravi_pm: Thanks Sam. Can you also call out webhook retry behavior? customer is sensitive to missed events.

sam_se: Yup — will show error patterns and config. Also drop a small triage FAQ in the thread after.

marta_cs: I'll own the pulse survey. Suggest single question: "Is the integration reliable enough to proceed to pilot?" with yes/no + comment. I'll send survey link after the sync.

nina_cs: Perfect. Marta — if more than 3 negative comments, mark as 'at-risk' and tag @ravi_pm. Also capture any asks re: SSO or VPC.

marta_cs: Noted. I'll add fields for SSO/VPC and expected timeline.

sam_se: Quick note: need demo token rotation before Tue. @deploy-bot can we get a short-lived token for demo-epsilon?

deploy-bot: Generated demo token id demo-eps-202 and posted to #secrets-mgmt (expires in 72h). :white_check_mark:

ravi_pm: For renewal signal — can CS flag accounts with low usage after week 2? If weekly active queries < 200, trigger stakeholder outreach.

nina_cs: Good rule. We'll add a 'usage' gate to cohort dashboard. Marta to pull week1 usage report on Friday EOD.

marta_cs: Will do. ETA Fri 5pm PT.

sam_se: After the sync I'll push a tiny README snippet for their engs with curl examples:

``
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer DEMO-EPS-202' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

nina_cs: Great. Last ask — can someone capture 1-2 signal metrics for the feedback loop (time to first successful inference, error rate)? Keep it lightweight.

sam_se: I'll capture TTFI and 5xx rate during demo.

marta_cs: Survey link: https://forms.redwood.ai/s/e9p

nina_cs: Thanks team — I'll run the invite and tag customer PMs. Follow up here with any blockers. :pray:
